statement: Build a one-file, phone-friendly website for Thread & Loom, a handloom clothing boutique in Pune, where visitors can browse and filter products, check sizes, see new arrivals and a lookbook, find the shop, read the policies and reviews, and place orders on WhatsApp. The look should feel earthy and elegant.
audience: Shoppers in and around Pune, mostly on phones, looking for handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas.
standards: Earthy, elegant look: natural, muted colours and refined type
Mobile first: easy to use on a 360px phone screen and good on a 1280px desktop
Only facts supplied by the Requester appear on the site; nothing invented
No stock images; photo spots stay plain and empty
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step (CDN libraries allowed)
rules: No product is marked as sale
The policy line 'No returns on sale items' stays in the return policy
Orders go through WhatsApp only, to +91 00000 11111
Prices are shown in rupees exactly as supplied
done_when: The site file shows the name Thread & Loom and Pune, includes a viewport meta tag, and uses an earthy colour palette defined in its CSS.

The site lists exactly these 10 products with these prices in rupees, grouped under Kurtas, Sarees, Shirts and Dupattas, and visitors can switch between categories: Indigo block-print kurta 1,499; Mustard handloom kurta 1,699; White chikankari kurta 2,199; Ikat handloom saree 3,499; Khadi silk saree 4,999; Cotton jamdani saree 3,999; Khadi cotton shirt 1,299; Linen-blend shirt 1,599; Block-print dupatta 899; Chanderi dupatta 1,099.

A size filter and a price filter work together with the category choice. Sizes per product: Indigo block-print kurta S to XXL; Mustard handloom kurta S to XL; White chikankari kurta XS to XL; Khadi cotton shirt S to XXL; Linen-blend shirt M to XXL; all sarees and dupattas Free size.
A size guide table shows chest in inches: XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42.
A New Arrivals section shows exactly: White chikankari kurta, Ikat handloom saree, Linen-blend shirt.
Every product has an order button that opens WhatsApp (wa.me/910000011111) with a ready message naming that product.
A lookbook section shows 3 styled outfits, each built only from the 10 listed products and naming them.
Every product card and lookbook card has a plain empty photo spot, the file contains no stock or placeholder photo images, and no product is marked as sale.
A store section shows the address 18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005, the timings 11am to 9pm Tuesday to Sunday with Monday closed, and the shop phone +91 00000 22222.
A return and exchange section states: exchange within 7 days if unworn with tags, and no returns on sale items.
A delivery note states: Pune in 2 days, Rs 79, free above Rs 2,999, pay on delivery.
A reviews section shows these three reviews with names: 'Beautiful fabric, fits perfectly' - Meera K.; 'Fast delivery and lovely packing' - Arjun S.; 'My go-to for festive kurtas' - Priya D.
The page has navigation links to each main section, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
The page runs with no JavaScript errors and has no horizontal overflow at 360px or 1280px width.
visitor_needs: See a lookbook of styled outfits
Read the return and exchange policy
